_comment: Third-party endpoints the authored pages call, and the path each one answers
to on this origin instead. Seeded into the CMS on `npm run seed`; after that
the CMS owns the records and the upstream URL is never returned by any public
The verification tools read this file so they can reproduce the substitution
without holding a credential. Only `slug` appears in rendered output, so
changing an upstream URL in the CMS does not make this file stale — adding,
removing or renaming an integration does.
Every value here was verified against the live platform by probing each
endpoint with a deliberately invalid payload, which is safe because it is
rejected. `availability` and `booking-lookup` are registered for GET, so
their inputs travel in the query string; `queryFields` names them.
ok      the browser is told success or failure and nothing else
fields  only the listed keys are copied out of the upstream response
Nothing is ever passed through wholesale.

integrations.label: Whitepaper download
integrations.note: The whitepaper modal. The e-mail with the document is sent by the workflow.

integrations.label: Demo request
integrations.note: The demo form on the product pages.

integrations.label: Appointment booking
integrations.note: Books the slot. The reference is shown to the visitor, so it is allowed through. Field names are snake_case: `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `datetime`.

integrations.label: Appointment availability
integrations.note: Reads free slots for the booking calendar. No lead: nobody has asked for anything yet. Registered for GET and takes no parameters — it returns the whole window.

integrations.label: Find a booking
integrations.note: Finds a booking from the link in the confirmation e-mail. Registered for GET; reads `ref` or `token` from the query string.

integrations.label: Confirm a booking
integrations.note: Confirms a booking from the e-mail link. Requires `token`.

integrations.label: Move a booking
integrations.note: Moves a booking. Requires `ref` or `token`, plus one of `new_datetime`, `lang`, `solution`.

integrations.label: Unsubscribe
integrations.note: Unsubscribes an address. The workflow behind this path was inactive when last probed — submissions are stored under Leads meanwhile.

integrations.label: Unsubscribe lookup
integrations.note: Looks an address up before unsubscribing it. The workflow behind this path was inactive when last probed.
